FAQ section heading
Frequently asked questions about All Trophies
FAQ 1 — PRODUCT
Q1 — Question
What are the best trophies for a sports club presentation night in Australia?
Q1 — Answer
Resin sport trophies (from $7.35) are the most popular choice — they feature sport-specific figurines and free engraving. Metal trophy cups suit major awards like Best & Fairest. Medals from $6.50 are ideal for full-team participation.
FAQ 2 — PRODUCT
Q2 — Question
What is the cheapest personalised trophy in Australia?
Q2 — Answer
The cheapest personalised trophies at Alpha Trophies start from $7.35 with free laser engraving included. For medals, prices start from $6.50 with a free neck ribbon. No minimum order — you can order as few as one.
FAQ 3 — PRODUCT
Q3 — Question
How long does trophy personalisation and engraving take?
Q3 — Answer
Standard orders are personalised and dispatched within 1–2 business days. With $9.90 flat-rate express shipping, most Australian customers receive orders within 3–5 business days total.
FAQ 4 — PRODUCT
Q4 — Question
Can I order trophies with my club or school logo in Australia?
Q4 — Answer
Yes. Alpha Trophies offers free colour logo printing and free laser engraving on all orders. Upload your PNG, JPG or vector logo at checkout. A free proof is provided for complex artwork.
FAQ 5 — PRODUCT
Q5 — Question
What is the difference between a trophy and a medal for a sports award?
Q5 — Answer
Trophies are typically given to top performers — Best & Fairest, Player of the Year. Medals are ideal for full-team participation awards because they're cost-effective and wearable from $6.50 each.
FAQ 6 — BUSINESS
Q6 — Question
Does Alpha Trophies offer same-day or express trophy orders?
Q6 — Answer
For urgent orders, call 1300 485 645. In-store pickup may be available same-day from Melbourne (Thomastown VIC), Adelaide (Prospect SA) or Sydney (Castle Hill NSW).
FAQ 7 — BUSINESS
Q7 — Question
Is there a minimum order quantity for trophies in Australia?
Q7 — Answer
No. Alpha Trophies has no minimum order quantity — you can order as few as one personalised trophy or medal.
FAQ 8 — BUSINESS
Q8 — Question
How do I set up a club or school account with Alpha Trophies?
Q8 — Answer
Register for a free Club or School Account at alphatrophies.com.au. Benefits include saved engraving templates, one-click reorder, priority production, and invoice billing.
FAQ 9 — BUSINESS
Q9 — Question
What bulk discounts does Alpha Trophies offer for clubs and schools?
Q9 — Answer
Contact our team for club and school pricing on large orders.
FAQ 10 — BUSINESS
Q10 — Question
Does Alpha Trophies ship trophies to all Australian states?
Q10 — Answer
Yes. $9.90 flat-rate express shipping to all states and territories. Free in-store pickup from Melbourne, Adelaide, and Sydney. Orders dispatched within 1–2 business days.

FAQ section heading
Frequently asked questions about Academic Trophies
FAQ 1 — PRODUCT
Q1 — Question
What are the best trophies for a school awards night in Australia?
Q1 — Answer
For school awards nights, resin figurine trophies ($7.35–$40) suit sports and activity awards while shield trophies or crystal awards suit academic excellence and dux categories. Participation medals from $6.50 with free ribbons cover full-year-level awards.
FAQ 2 — PRODUCT
Q2 — Question
Can I order academic trophies with the school crest?
Q2 — Answer
Yes — free colour logo printing is included on all orders. Upload your school crest PNG or JPG at checkout. For complex crests or vector artwork, a free proof is provided before production.
FAQ 3 — BUSINESS
Q3 — Question
How do I order trophies for an entire school presentation night?
Q3 — Answer
Set up a free School Account to access invoice billing, saved engraving templates, and priority production. You can build your full order online and submit for bulk pricing. Contact our team for orders of 50+ items.
FAQ 4 — PRODUCT
Q4 — Question
What is the difference between a shield trophy and a figurine trophy for school awards?
Q4 — Answer
Figurine trophies suit sports and activity awards. Shield trophies and plaques are traditionally used for academic achievement, dux of school, and leadership awards — they display well on a wall or desk.
FAQ 5 — BUSINESS
Q5 — Question
How long does it take to make personalised school trophies?
Q5 — Answer
Standard school orders are dispatched within 1–2 business days. For large orders over 50 items, allow 2–3 business days. Express school orders are available — call 1300 485 645.
FAQ 6 — BUSINESS
Q6 — Question
Are there bulk discounts for school trophy orders?
Q6 — Answer
Yes — contact our team for school pricing on orders of 20 or more trophies or medals. School Account holders also receive priority production and invoice billing.
FAQ 7 — PRODUCT
Q7 — Question
Can I mix trophies and medals in the same school order?
Q7 — Answer
Yes — you can mix trophies, medals, shields, and ribbons in a single order. Each item can have individual engraving at no extra charge.
FAQ 8 — PRODUCT
Q8 — Question
What academic trophy sizes are available?
Q8 — Answer
Academic and school trophies range from 105mm mini stars to 360mm full-height presentation trophies. We recommend 200–250mm for major academic awards and 105–150mm for participation awards.
